name: [Kasir][Izin][CUST-01] Cashier cannot open customer management
description: Customer create/edit/delete belongs to admins; a cashier opening the customer form directly must be refused.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Verify the page shows an access-denied (403) message or redirects back to the cashier screen, and no customer creation form with a name field and a save button is shown

name: [Kasir][Izin][SRET-01] Cashier cannot open the sales return form
description: Sales returns move stock and post journals; the cashier role must not reach the return entry screen.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account
Verify the page shows an access-denied (403) message or redirects to the cashier screen, and no return form with a receipt selector and product rows is shown

name: [Kasir][Izin][PROC-05] Cashier cannot print a stock transfer delivery note
description: Delivery notes expose other branches' stock movements; a cashier must not be able to open them by id.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in with the environment's test account

Verify the page shows an access-denied (403) or not-found (404) message, and no delivery note naming GUDANG MAJU BERSAMA as source and TOKO MAJU BERSAMA ECERAN as destination with item quantities is rendered
